title: Pumpkin Patties
description: Savoury patties made from roasted pumpkin or butternut squash, fresh thyme and rolled oats. Crispy on top, tender inside — serve alongside soup or salad.

ingredients.text: 800g peeled, deseeded and chopped pumpkin (or butternut squash)
Handful of fresh thyme, leaves picked and finely chopped

steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C/180°C fan. Spread the pumpkin on a foil-lined tray, sprinkle with thyme and roast for 30 minutes.
Leave the oven on. Tip the roasted pumpkin into a bowl and mash. Add the oats and mix until rollable — add more oats if too runny.
Roll into 50p-piece-sized balls and spread on a baking sheet lined with greaseproof paper.
Flatten with a fork and bake for 20 more minutes until just crispy on top.
Use a fish slice to remove from the sheet and serve.
notes: Makes around 18 patties. Per patty estimate.
